display.purpose: Page headings; compact discovery and dedicated event headings use the documented smaller overrides.

title.purpose: Supporting h3 headings, including the empty preview.

event-title.purpose: Result titles with open leading for long provider names.

body.purpose: Base reading text; labeled filter inputs retain this size with weight 500.

body-small.purpose: Descriptions and practical event-section copy, limited to 70ch.

label.purpose: Visible form labels and utility text links.

navigation.purpose: Labeled sidebar links at weight 550; compact rail/bottom labels reduce to .6875rem.

navigation-current.purpose: Current sidebar destination at weight 700; compact current destinations retain this weight.

navigation-group.purpose: Browse and Your space section headings, with .02em tracking.

small-label.purpose: Plain event-date lines with body leading and tabular numerals; sidebar customization labels also retain this leading.

quiet-action.purpose: Unavailable participation buttons and event-section links with the inherited text-sm leading ratio; current section links rise to weight 800.

availability.purpose: Neutral planned-feature badges with the inherited text-xs leading ratio, not date-index or selection styling.

metadata.purpose: Supporting event facts, freshness, source notes, and availability explanations; collapsed tooltips use this size with weight 650.

date-number.purpose: The stacked date marker's day; horizontal row indexes use .9375rem instead.

shadows.name: drag-insertion-before
shadows.purpose: Functional plum insertion rule before a reorder target during sidebar customization; not cast depth.

shadows.name: drag-insertion-after
shadows.purpose: Functional plum insertion rule after a reorder target during sidebar customization; the normal interface has no cast shadows.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for action fill, sidebar width, disclosure-chevron rotation, and selected-result fill.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Action background-color, sidebar grid-template-columns, and filter-chevron transform transitions.

motion.name: library-button-state
motion.purpose: The library's default button timing for navigation and other buttons without an app-specific duration; the theme limits transitions to background-color and color.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes transition/animation durations and forces scroll-behavior: auto, all with !important.

narrative.overview:
Local frequency makes event discovery feel personally assembled: the presence of a record shop, the intimacy of a mixtape, and the clarity of an everyday planning tool. Deep plum actions and pale-plum selection sit within light-stone navigation and near-white reading surfaces; compact dusty-rose date indexes give the collection a warm, human rhythm.

Bold, readable Manrope and real provider photography carry the personality. Familiar labeled controls keep everyday planning practical: useful dates, venues, prices, and clear availability matter more than promotional decoration. Density changes with the available space while the event identity stays recognizable.
keyCharacteristics: Deep plum actions and pale-plum selection against light-stone navigation, near-white paper, and white surfaces.
Dusty-rose date indexing and neutral, honest availability labels.
One expressive, readable Manrope family with substantial heading weights.
Record-sleeve provider imagery and compact, aligned event facts.
Border-only depth, restrained state transitions, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Plum State, Rose Date Rule
rules.body: Plum carries actions, focus, and selection; dusty rose belongs only to date indexing. Availability stays neutral, and every navigation layout shares the pale-plum current state.

rules.name: The One Family, Clear Roles Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope's size, weight, leading, and spacing to distinguish headings, facts, and controls; keep dates tabular and long event names able to wrap.

rules.name: The Border-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with tone, spacing, and borders; selection changes the fill without lifting the component or adding a cast shadow.

dos: Do use plum for actions, focus, and selection; light stone for navigation; near-white surfaces for reading; and dusty rose only for date indexes.
Do keep real provider imagery, full readable dates, venue, price availability, and sale status connected to the event title.
Do preserve the 62rem context/rail threshold and 72rem full-sidebar threshold when extending the shared shell.
Do keep visible focus, wrapping titles, labeled controls, reduced motion, and ordinary link/form behavior.
Do explain unavailable participation, unknown event facts, and stale provider data in text.
Do keep sidebar editing explicit, cancellable, keyboard accessible, and truthful about browser-only persistence.
donts: Don't add cast shadows, glass effects, or raised hover cards to this flat, border-defined system.
Don't force provider photographs into monochrome or substitute decorative stock imagery for event identity.
Don't style planned accounts, saves, interest, recommendations, or discussions as completed actions or fabricate participation counts.
Don't use promotional clutter or manufactured urgency to compete with practical event information.
Don't promote route-specific composition or synthesized sidecar tonal ramps into new global design tokens.
Don't reuse date paper for selected rows, current navigation, availability labels, caret, or focus.
